name: DUMBBELL SIDE BEND RIGHT
introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Put your right hand on your waist and have your left hand hold a dumbbell at your side. \n\nBend your body to your left side and lower your left hand towards the floor. Pause for one second and return to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Inhale when you bend down, and exhale when you go back to the starting position.
